camera.shot_scale_bias: close handheld shots that drift around the subject
camera.height: low, moving through grass and around bodies

lens.focal_bias: a very wide 12-21mm lens held close to the subject
lens.dof: deep focus with the sky and horizon always present behind

lighting.practicals: the sun sits in or near the frame and flares across the lens

palette.grade: warm and luminous with lifted shadows

rules: a very low horizon with a large sky
hands and grass in the near foreground
composition.movement_of_subject: people wander in and out of frame while the camera drifts past them

sound.ambience_bias: wind, insects, water, cloth and grass at close range

music.instrumentation: Sustained orchestral strings with a slow rising figure
music.dynamics: swelling continuously without arriving at a resolution

must_include: the camera drifts continuously and never locks off
low sun flares directly into the lens

notes: Wide lens held close, endless drifting movement, natural low sun. The camera behaves like a wandering observer rather than a stationed one.
